title: 测试路径与正式发布路径的一致性
summary: 不能只验证某个组件在快速 CI 中可用；正式发布流水线必须实际打包并验证同一被测试实现，否则会产生“测试绿、成品缺组件”的发布路径不对称。
invariants: A release artifact MUST contain every component whose presence is assumed by release qualification.
Production packaging SHOULD verify required files inside the produced artifact.
Build identity SHOULD record component revision/hash when that component affects runtime behavior.
Release publication SHOULD fail if required assets/components are absent.

provenance.note: H9 production APK omitted tested mkvgo bridge until production workflow was hardened.
